iriPlumeBundle = FileAttachment("/data/KE-enso-explorer/iri_forecast_plume.json").json()
iodPlumeBundle = FileAttachment("/data/KE-enso-explorer/iod_forecast_plume.json").json()

sec2PlumeHero = {
  if (!iriPlumeBundle || !iriPlumeBundle.current) {
    return html`<div style="padding: 1rem; color: #b91c1c;">Forecast Plume feed unavailable.</div>`;
  }

  const container = html`<div style="width: 100%;"></div>`;

  // Reactive default driver from global driverKind selector, can also be toggled locally
  let activeDriver = (driverKind && driverKind.includes("IOD")) ? "IOD" : "ENSO";
  let ensoMetricSpace = "NINO34"; // "NINO34" (Raw CCSR/IRI Plume) | "RONI" (Translated Teleconnection Gradient)
  let hindcastSeasons = 6;
  let overlayMode = "top3"; // "none", "top3", "top5"
  const analogueColors = ["#d97706", "#7c3aed", "#059669", "#0891b2", "#e11d48"];

  const seasons_order = ['DJF', 'JFM', 'FMA', 'MAM', 'AMJ', 'MJJ', 'JJA', 'JAS', 'ASO', 'SON', 'OND', 'NDJ'];

  // Forecast horizon comes from the bundles themselves (current.seasons + current.seasonYears,
  // written by scripts/fetch_iri_plume.py and _sources/sintex_iod_build.py) — no typed years.
  function bundleHorizon(b) {
    const seasons = (b && b.current && Array.isArray(b.current.seasons)) ? b.current.seasons : [];
    let years = (b && b.current && Array.isArray(b.current.seasonYears) && b.current.seasonYears.length === seasons.length)
      ? b.current.seasonYears : null;
    if (!years) {
      // legacy bundle without seasonYears: seasons belong to the issue year until the DJF rollover
      let y = (b && b.current && b.current.issueYear) || new Date().getUTCFullYear();
      years = seasons.map((s, i) => { if (i > 0 && s === 'DJF') y += 1; return y; });
    }
    return { seasons, years };
  }
  const horizonENSO = bundleHorizon(iriPlumeBundle);
  const horizonIOD = bundleHorizon(iodPlumeBundle);
  const horizonsWithData = [horizonENSO, horizonIOD].filter(h => h.years.length);
  const firstYear = horizonsWithData.length ? Math.min(...horizonsWithData.map(h => h.years[0])) : new Date().getUTCFullYear();
  const lastYear = horizonsWithData.length ? Math.max(...horizonsWithData.map(h => h.years[h.years.length - 1])) : firstYear + 1;
  // Calendar window: SON two years before the first forecast year .. end of the last forecast year
  const all_seasons = [];
  for (const y of d3.range(firstYear - 2, lastYear + 1)) {
    for (const s of seasons_order) {
      if (y === firstYear - 2 && seasons_order.indexOf(s) < seasons_order.indexOf('SON')) continue;
      const short_y = String(y).slice(2);
      all_seasons.push({
        season: s,
        year: y,
        id: s + '_' + y,
        label: s + " '" + short_y
      });
    }
  }
  // trim the window to the last forecast season of either bundle
  {
    const lastIds = horizonsWithData.map(h => `${h.seasons[h.seasons.length - 1]}_${h.years[h.years.length - 1]}`);
    const cut = Math.max(...lastIds.map(id => all_seasons.findIndex(s => s.id === id)));
    if (cut >= 0) all_seasons.length = cut + 1;
  }

  function renderPlume() {
    const isIOD = (activeDriver === "IOD");
    const bundle = isIOD ? iodPlumeBundle : iriPlumeBundle;
    if (!bundle || !bundle.current) return;

    const isRoniSpace = (!isIOD && ensoMetricSpace === "RONI");

    const themeColor = isIOD ? "#0f766e" : (isRoniSpace ? "#0284c7" : "#2563eb");
    const themeBg = isIOD ? "#f0fdfa" : (isRoniSpace ? "#f0f9ff" : "#eff6ff");
    const ribbonColor = isIOD ? "#99f6e4" : (isRoniSpace ? "#bae6fd" : "#93c5fd");

    // Build observed map dynamically from seasonalDrivers (Decision D17.1, D17.4, KE-42)
    const obs_map = {};
    for (const s of all_seasons) {
      let driverKey;
      if (isIOD) {
        driverKey = `DMI_CPC_${s.season}_${s.year}`;
      } else if (isRoniSpace) {
        driverKey = `RONI_${s.season}_${s.year}`;
      } else {
        driverKey = `NINO34_${s.season}_${s.year}`;
      }
      let val = seasonalDriverMap ? seasonalDriverMap.get(driverKey) : null;
      if (val == null && isIOD && seasonalDriverMap) {
        val = seasonalDriverMap.get(`DMI_${s.season}_${s.year}`);
      }
      if (val == null && !isIOD && !isRoniSpace && seasonalDriverMap) {
        val = seasonalDriverMap.get(`RONI_${s.season}_${s.year}`);
      }
      if (val != null) {
        obs_map[s.id] = val;
      }
    }

    let latestObsVal;
    if (isIOD) {
      latestObsVal = currentState?.dmiLatest ?? null;
    } else if (isRoniSpace) {
      latestObsVal = currentState?.roniLatest ?? null;
    } else {
      latestObsVal = currentState?.nino34Latest ?? currentState?.roniLatest ?? null;
    }

    // Forward forecast ensemble statistics for the bundle's own forecast seasons
    const horizon = isIOD ? horizonIOD : horizonENSO;
    const fcstSeasons = horizon.seasons;
    const fcstYears = horizon.years;
    const firstFcstYear = fcstYears[0];
    const fcstStats = [];

    // Anchor at the season immediately before the first forecast season (e.g. JAS before ASO)
    const firstFcstPos = all_seasons.findIndex(s => s.id === `${fcstSeasons[0]}_${firstFcstYear}`);
    const anchorSeason = firstFcstPos > 0 ? all_seasons[firstFcstPos - 1] : null;
    const anchorVal = anchorSeason ? (obs_map[anchorSeason.id] ?? latestObsVal) : latestObsVal;
    if (anchorSeason && anchorVal != null) {
      fcstStats.push({
        label: anchorSeason.label,
        season: anchorSeason.season,
        year: anchorSeason.year,
        min: anchorVal,
        max: anchorVal,
        median: anchorVal,
        mean: anchorVal,
        count: bundle.current.models.length
      });
    }

    // Dynamic offset at anchor for transition relaxation (Architecture C, KE-42)
    let delta0 = 0.45;
    if (anchorSeason && seasonalDriverMap) {
      const ninoAnchor = seasonalDriverMap.get(`NINO34_${anchorSeason.season}_${anchorSeason.year}`);
      const roniAnchor = seasonalDriverMap.get(`RONI_${anchorSeason.season}_${anchorSeason.year}`);
      if (ninoAnchor != null && roniAnchor != null) {
        delta0 = Math.max(0, ninoAnchor - roniAnchor);
      }
    }

    fcstSeasons.forEach((s, idx) => {
      const sy = fcstYears[idx];
      let deltaOffset = 0;
      if (isRoniSpace) {
        const leadSeasons = idx + 1; // 1-based forecast step
        const tMonths = leadSeasons * 3;
        const tau = 6.0; // 6-month relaxation timescale
        const deltaSecular = 0.35; // +0.35 °C secular baseline warming (2015-2026 empirical mean)
        deltaOffset = delta0 * Math.exp(-tMonths / tau) + deltaSecular * (1.0 - Math.exp(-tMonths / tau));
      }

      const vals = bundle.current.models
        .map(m => {
          const raw = m.data[idx];
          if (raw == null) return null;
          return isRoniSpace ? (raw - deltaOffset) : raw;
        })
        .filter(v => v != null)
        .sort((a,b) => a - b);
      if (vals.length > 0) {
        fcstStats.push({
          label: s + " '" + String(sy).slice(2),
          season: s,
          year: sy,
          min: d3.min(vals),
          max: d3.max(vals),
          median: d3.median(vals),
          mean: d3.mean(vals),
          count: vals.length
        });
      }
    });

    const firstFcstIdx = firstFcstPos;
    let startIdx = firstFcstIdx - hindcastSeasons;
    if (hindcastSeasons === 0) startIdx = firstFcstIdx - 1; // anchor at the season before the first forecast
    startIdx = Math.max(0, startIdx);

    const visibleSeasons = all_seasons.slice(startIdx);
    const domainLabels = visibleSeasons.map(s => s.label);

    const visibleObs = [];
    visibleSeasons.forEach(s => {
      if (obs_map[s.id] != null && all_seasons.indexOf(s) < firstFcstIdx) {
        visibleObs.push({ label: s.label, val: obs_map[s.id] });
      }
    });

    const isOND = (activeSeason === "OND");
    const targetCode = isOND ? 'OND' : 'MAM';
    const targetIdx = fcstSeasons.indexOf(targetCode);
    const targetYear = targetIdx >= 0 ? fcstYears[targetIdx] : (isOND ? firstFcstYear : firstFcstYear + 1);
    const targetSeasonKey = `${targetCode}_${targetYear}`;
    const targetSeasonLabel = `${targetCode} '${String(targetYear).slice(2)}`;
    const targetSeasonTitle = isOND ? `OND ${targetYear} (Short Rains)` : `MAM ${targetYear} (Long Rains)`;

    const targetStat = fcstStats.find(d => d.season === targetCode && d.year === targetYear) || fcstStats.find(d => d.season === targetCode) || null;
    const targetMedian = targetStat ? targetStat.median : null;
    const targetMin = targetStat ? targetStat.min : null;
    const targetMax = targetStat ? targetStat.max : null;
    const fmtSigned = (v) => (v == null || !Number.isFinite(v)) ? 'n/a' : `${v >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${v.toFixed(2)}`;
    // Monthly products: the next issue is expected around the 20th of the month after the release month.
    const nextIssueNote = (b) => {
      const ry = b?.metadata?.releaseYear, rm = b?.metadata?.releaseMonth;
      if (!ry || !rm) return 'next issue: monthly';
      const d = new Date(Date.UTC(ry, rm, 20));
      return `next issue expected ~${d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', year: 'numeric', timeZone: 'UTC' })}`;
    };

    const targetDeltaOffset = (isRoniSpace && targetIdx >= 0)
      ? (delta0 * Math.exp(-(targetIdx + 1) * 3 / 6.0) + 0.35 * (1.0 - Math.exp(-(targetIdx + 1) * 3 / 6.0)))
      : 0;
    const rawTargetVals = bundle.current.models.map(m => m.data[targetIdx]).filter(v => v != null);
    const targetVals = isRoniSpace ? rawTargetVals.map(v => v - targetDeltaOffset) : rawTargetVals;

    // Agreement %
    let targetAgreementText = "";
    if (isIOD) {
      const neutralCount = targetVals.filter(v => v >= -0.4 && v <= 0.4).length;
      const pct = Math.round((neutralCount / targetVals.length) * 100);
      targetAgreementText = `${pct}% Neutral IOD (-0.4 to +0.4 °C)`;
    } else {
      const elNinoCount = targetVals.filter(v => v >= 0.5).length;
      const pct = Math.round((elNinoCount / targetVals.length) * 100);
      targetAgreementText = `${pct}% El Niño (> +0.5 °C)`;
    }

    const targetAverages = bundle.current.averages || {};
    const rawDynAvg = targetIdx >= 0 ? (targetAverages.dynamical?.[targetIdx] ?? null) : null;
    const rawStatAvg = targetIdx >= 0 ? (targetAverages.statistical?.[targetIdx] ?? null) : null;
    const dynAvg = rawDynAvg != null ? (isRoniSpace ? (rawDynAvg - targetDeltaOffset) : rawDynAvg) : null;
    const statAvg = rawStatAvg != null ? (isRoniSpace ? (rawStatAvg - targetDeltaOffset) : rawStatAvg) : null;

    // Thresholds and domains
    const threshUpper = isIOD ? 0.4 : 0.5;
    const threshLower = isIOD ? -0.4 : -0.5;
    const yDomain = isIOD ? [-1.5, 1.5] : [-2.0, 4.4];
    const yLabel = isIOD 
      ? "↑ Dipole Mode Index (DMI, °C)" 
      : (isRoniSpace ? "↑ Relative Oceanic Niño Index (RONI, °C)" : "↑ Niño 3.4 SST Anomaly (°C)");

    const marks = [
      // Background Phase Zones
      Plot.rectY([{y1: threshUpper, y2: yDomain[1]}], {y1: "y1", y2: "y2", fill: "#fef2f2", fillOpacity: 0.65}),
      Plot.rectY([{y1: threshLower, y2: threshUpper}], {y1: "y1", y2: "y2", fill: "#f8fafc", fillOpacity: 0.5}),
      Plot.rectY([{y1: yDomain[0], y2: threshLower}], {y1: "y1", y2: "y2", fill: "#f0f9ff", fillOpacity: 0.65}),

      // Reference Rules
      Plot.ruleY([threshUpper], {stroke: "#dc2626", strokeDasharray: "3,3", strokeWidth: 1.2}),
      Plot.ruleY([threshLower], {stroke: "#0284c7", strokeDasharray: "3,3", strokeWidth: 1.2}),
      Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "#94a3b8", strokeWidth: 1}),

      // Highlight target season column
      Plot.ruleX([targetSeasonLabel], {
        stroke: isIOD ? "#0f766e" : (isRoniSpace ? "#0284c7" : "#2563eb"),
        strokeWidth: 46,
        strokeOpacity: 0.12
      }),
      Plot.ruleX([targetSeasonLabel], {
        stroke: isIOD ? "#0d9488" : (isRoniSpace ? "#0284c7" : "#3b82f6"),
        strokeWidth: 1.5,
        strokeDasharray: "4,4"
      }),
      Plot.text([targetSeasonLabel], {
        y: () => yDomain[1],
        text: () => `★ Focus: ${targetSeasonLabel}`,
        dy: 12,
        fill: isIOD ? "#0f766e" : (isRoniSpace ? "#0369a1" : "#1d4ed8"),
        fontWeight: 800,
        fontSize: 10.5,
        textAnchor: "middle"
      }),

      // Shaded Multi-Model Ensemble Spread Ribbon (Min to Max)
      Plot.areaY(fcstStats, {
        x: "label",
        y1: "min",
        y2: "max",
        fill: ribbonColor,
        fillOpacity: 0.5,
        title: d => `${d.label} Ensemble Spread: ${d.min >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${d.min.toFixed(2)} to ${d.max >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${d.max.toFixed(2)} °C`
      }),

      // Multi-Model Ensemble Median Line
      Plot.line(fcstStats, {
        x: "label",
        y: "median",
        stroke: themeColor,
        strokeWidth: 2.8
      }),
      Plot.dot(fcstStats, {
        x: "label",
        y: "median",
        fill: themeColor,
        stroke: "#ffffff",
        strokeWidth: 1.2,
        r: 4,
        title: d => `${d.label} Ensemble Median: ${d.median >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${d.median.toFixed(2)} °C (Spread: ${d.min >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${d.min.toFixed(2)} to ${d.max >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${d.max.toFixed(2)} °C; ${bundle.current.models.length} models)`
      }),

      // Observed Line and Dots
      Plot.line(visibleObs, {
        x: "label",
        y: "val",
        stroke: "#0f172a",
        strokeWidth: 2.2
      }),
      Plot.dot(visibleObs, {
        x: "label",
        y: "val",
        fill: "#0f172a",
        stroke: "#ffffff",
        strokeWidth: 1.2,
        r: 4,
        title: d => `Observed ${d.label}: ${d.val >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${d.val.toFixed(2)} °C`
      })
    ];

    if (!isIOD) {
      marks.push(Plot.ruleY([2.0], {stroke: "#b91c1c", strokeDasharray: "2,4", strokeWidth: 0.9}));
    }

    // Overlay Historical Analogue Traces if enabled
    let topAnalogues = [];
    if (overlayMode !== "none") {
      const topN = (overlayMode === "top3") ? 3 : 5;
      topAnalogues = (analogueYears && analogueYears.length) ? analogueYears.slice(0, topN) : [];

      topAnalogues.forEach((a, aIdx) => {
        const col = analogueColors[aIdx % analogueColors.length];
        const pts = [];
        visibleSeasons.forEach(s => {
          const yrOffset = s.year - firstFcstYear;
          const targetHistYear = a.year + yrOffset;
          const key = isIOD 
            ? `DMI_${s.season}_${targetHistYear}`
            : (isRoniSpace ? `RONI_${s.season}_${targetHistYear}` : `NINO34_${s.season}_${targetHistYear}`);
          let val = seasonalDriverMap ? seasonalDriverMap.get(key) : null;
          if (val == null && !isIOD && !isRoniSpace && seasonalDriverMap) {
            val = seasonalDriverMap.get(`RONI_${s.season}_${targetHistYear}`);
          }
          if (val != null) {
            pts.push({ label: s.label, season: s.season, val: val, year: a.year, rank: a.rank, color: col });
          }
        });

        if (pts.length > 0) {
          const anchorPts = pts.filter(p => p.season === "OND" || p.season === "ASO");
          marks.push(
            Plot.line(pts, {
              x: "label",
              y: "val",
              stroke: col,
              strokeWidth: 2.0,
              strokeDasharray: "4,3",
              title: d => `${a.year} (#${a.rank} Analogue) ${d.label}: ${d.val >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${d.val.toFixed(2)} °C`
            }),
            Plot.dot(anchorPts, {
              x: "label",
              y: "val",
              fill: col,
              stroke: "#ffffff",
              strokeWidth: 1.2,
              r: 4.0,
              title: d => `${a.year} (#${a.rank} Analogue) ${d.label} Anchor: ${d.val >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${d.val.toFixed(2)} °C`
            })
          );
          // Direct terminal label at the right margin to avoid any OND text collisions
          const termPt = pts[pts.length - 1];
          if (termPt) {
            marks.push(
              Plot.text([termPt], {
                x: "label",
                y: "val",
                text: d => `${a.year} (#${a.rank})`,
                fill: col,

sec4Profile = {
  const y = sec4SelectedYear;
  const aMatch = (analogueYears && analogueYears.length) ? analogueYears.find((d) => d.year === y) : null;
  const rank = aMatch ? aMatch.rank : null;
  const distStr = aMatch ? aMatch.distStr : null;
  
  // 1. Ocean state
  const roni = aMatch?.roni_pred != null ? aMatch.roni_pred : (rawSeasonMean("roni", "OND", y) || 0);
  const dmi = aMatch?.dmi_pred != null ? aMatch.dmi_pred : (rawSeasonMean("dmi_hadisst", "OND", y) || 0);
  const ensoTag = roni >= 1.5 ? "Very Strong El Niño" : roni >= 1.0 ? "Strong El Niño" : roni >= 0.5 ? "Moderate El Niño" : roni <= -1.0 ? "Strong La Niña" : roni <= -0.5 ? "Moderate La Niña" : "Neutral ENSO";
  const iodTag = dmi >= 0.4 ? "Positive IOD (+Dipole)" : dmi <= -0.4 ? "Negative IOD (-Dipole)" : "Neutral IOD";

  // 2. CHIRPS rainfall
  const ondRow = sec31Rain.find((d) => d.year === y && d.period === "OND");
  const mamRow = sec31Rain.find((d) => d.year === y && d.period === "MAM");
  const ondVal = ondRow ? Math.round(ondRow.value_mean) : null;
  const mamVal = mamRow ? Math.round(mamRow.value_mean) : null;
  const ondAnom = ondVal != null && sec31ClimOND > 0 ? Math.round(((ondVal - sec31ClimOND) / sec31ClimOND) * 100) : null;
  const mamAnom = mamVal != null && sec31ClimMAM > 0 ? Math.round(((mamVal - sec31ClimMAM) / sec31ClimMAM) * 100) : null;

  // 3. Pasture NDVI
  const ndviRows = ndviCty.filter((d) => {
    const yr = Number(d.date.slice(0, 4));
    const mo = Number(d.date.slice(5, 7));
    return (yr === y && mo >= 10) || (yr === y + 1 && mo <= 2);
  });
  const ndviAvg = ndviRows.length ? Math.round(d3.mean(ndviRows, (d) => d.ndvi_pct_normal)) : null;

  // 4. Terms of Trade / market (NDMA / FEWS NET retail monitoring started in 2008 for 20 ASAL counties)
  const totList = totRows.filter((d) => d.year === y);
  const totAvg = totList.length ? (d3.median(totList, (d) => d.tot)).toFixed(1) : null;
  const totMinRow = totList.length ? d3.least(totList, (d) => d.tot) : null;
  const totMin = totMinRow ? (totMinRow.tot).toFixed(1) : null;
  const totMinMo = totMinRow ? ["Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"][totMinRow.month - 1] : null;

  // 5. Synthesis text
  let synTitle = `Table 2.1 • Two-Season Compound Historical Outcome Record (${y}: MAM + OND)`;
  let synDesc = "";
  let synPrecedent = "";

  if (ondAnom != null && mamAnom != null) {
    const mamSign = mamAnom >= 0 ? `+${mamAnom}%` : `${mamAnom}%`;
    const ondSign = ondAnom >= 0 ? `+${ondAnom}%` : `${ondAnom}%`;

    if (mamAnom >= 10 && ondAnom >= 10) {
      synDesc = `In historical analogue year ${y}, ${county} experienced consecutive wet seasons: the March–May (MAM) Long Rains were heavy (${mamSign} anomaly), followed by high October–December (OND) Short Rains (${ondSign} anomaly, ${ondVal} mm total). This compound rainfall surge triggered substantial pastoral pasture flush and bumper agricultural output, though localized riverine flash flooding and road infrastructure severance were observed in low-lying subcounties.`;
      synPrecedent = `Consecutive wet seasons provide significant forage recovery and recharge municipal water pans, but county disaster committees must pre-position water purification chemicals and repair damaged road culverts.`;
    } else if (mamAnom >= 10 && ondAnom < -10) {
      synDesc = `In historical analogue year ${y}, the March–May (MAM) Long Rains produced a strong positive buffer (${mamSign} anomaly, ${mamVal} mm), which cushioned ${county} against subsequent Short Rains (OND) dryness (${ondSign} anomaly, ${ondVal} mm). Rangeland forage held through early dry spells due to adequate soil moisture reserves accumulated earlier in the year.`;
      synPrecedent = `A favorable Long Rains season acts as an essential ecological and economic shock-absorber, preventing acute famine declarations even when the subsequent Short Rains underperform.`;
    } else if (mamAnom < -10 && ondAnom >= 10) {
      synDesc = `In historical analogue year ${y}, an initial Long Rains (MAM) deficit (${mamSign} anomaly) was rapidly broken by intense Short Rains (OND) rainfall (${ondSign} anomaly, ${ondVal} mm total). Vegetative browse and pasture NDVI rebounded rapidly, transitioning livestock herds from severe forage stress into lush pasture conditions within two dekads.`;
      synPrecedent = `Sudden heavy rainfall following dry spells creates severe hypothermia risk for weakened livestock and triggers epizootic disease vectors (CCPP and RVF). Pre-emptive ring-vaccination and shelter protection are required.`;
    } else if (mamAnom < -10 && ondAnom < -10) {
      synDesc = `In historical analogue year ${y}, ${county} suffered a compound multi-season drought: both the MAM Long Rains (${mamSign} anomaly) and OND Short Rains (${ondSign} anomaly) failed. Pasture biomass collapsed, Terms of Trade plunged as livestock market prices crashed relative to staple maize, and county emergency response required emergency water trucking and livestock feed subsidies.`;
      synPrecedent = `Multi-season consecutive drought is the primary driver of catastrophic herd depletion in pastoral ASALs. Commercial off-take triggers must activate early during the first season of failure.`;
    } else {
      synDesc = `In historical analogue year ${y}, seasonal rainfall tracked near long-term climatological medians in ${county} (MAM: ${mamSign}; OND: ${ondSign}, ${ondVal} mm total). Agricultural production and rangeland forage dynamics exhibited stable baseline performance without severe acute shock indicators.`;
      synPrecedent = `Near-normal seasons provide ideal windows for strategic asset building, rangeland reseeding, and maintenance of water pans and irrigation canals.`;
    }
  } else {
    synDesc = `Historical records for analogue year ${y} document an equatorial Pacific ocean state of ${roni >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${roni.toFixed(2)} °C (RONI) paired with an Indian Ocean Dipole index of ${dmi >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${dmi.toFixed(2)} °C (HadISST).`;
    synPrecedent = `Compare localized historical impacts against current seasonal advisories issued by the County Director of Meteorology (CDM).`;
  }

  return {
    year: y,
    rank, distStr,
    roni, dmi, ensoTag, iodTag,
    ondVal, ondAnom, mamVal, mamAnom,
    ndviAvg, totAvg, totMin, totMinMo,
    synTitle, synDesc, synPrecedent
  };
}
